description:
MATLAB code and processed model output that reproduce Figures 1-4, Supporting Information Figures S1-S13 and Table S1 of the article "Background Conditions and Patch Dispersion Shape the Responses to Iron Fertilization in the Subarctic Eastern North Pacific" (Geophysical Research Letters, in review).

The study uses nested ROMS-BEC simulations at 12, 4 and 1 km horizontal resolution around Ocean Station Papa in 2010, with 18 ocean iron fertilization experiments (releases in May-August at region R1 and in June at regions R2 and R3, each at the three resolutions) and their control runs.

The plot scripts (plot/, tables/) read only the 15 MAT files in data/ and write the figures (figures/) and Table S1 (tables/); make_all_figures runs them all in under two minutes. The figures need MATLAB and, for the maps, M_Map. The prep scripts (prep/) document how data/ was built from intermediate products of the model output (about 13.7 GB, not included). README.md maps every figure to its script and data files, documents every data file, and lists the model runs, the provenance of the data and the third-party data sources.
